category_title: Social fourth-grade student with learning disabilities who frequently seeks teacher assistance
minimal_context: Julia is working independently on an expository writing task about her favorite holiday using a graphic organizer.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We have thirty minutes of writing time today. The prompt is: Everyone has a favorite holiday. Think about your favorite holiday and explain how you celebrate it. Please work independently on your first draft.

STUDENT: (Raises hand immediately) I don't know what to do. I can't get started on my writing.

TUTOR: Just pick a holiday you like and write down a few sentences about it.

STUDENT: Okay, I wrote: 'Everybody has a favorite holiday . Mine is easter. I like to paint the eggs . I like to find the egg’s to.' But I don't know what else to write.

TUTOR: Keep trying. Look at your paper and add some more details about painting the eggs.

STUDENT: (Raises hand again, complaining) I added 'Once I painted A egg orange and blue whitch is the gator colors', but I can't move further! This is too hard and I need you to come help me right now.

options.A: Implement choice-making as a prevention strategy for the writing task.
options.B: Guide Julia to plan her writing using the graphic organizer.
options.C: Provide a touch on her shoulder during the writing task.
options.D: Withhold attention when Julia engages in complaining about the task.
